definitions.explanation: Having to do with the structure of something: of a building or object, its construction; of a society, economy or organization, rooted in how it is built rather than in chance or individuals. Common in news and analysis: {構造的|こうぞうてき}な{問題|もんだい}, a structural problem.

examples.japanese: {構造的|こうぞうてき}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{構造的|こうぞうてき}な⟦{欠陥|けっかん}→欠陥：02793_kekkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: A structural defect was found in this bridge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人手不足|ひとでぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一時的|いちじてき}→一時的：05846_ichijiteki⟧なもの⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{構造的|こうぞうてき}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
examples.english: The labour shortage is not temporary but a structural problem caused by the falling birthrate.

notes:
⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧ (structure) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (-al). Often set against ⟦{一時的|いちじてき}→一時的：05846_ichijiteki⟧ (temporary): a problem that will not go away by itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {構造的|こうぞうてき}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ / ⟦{要因|よういん}→要因：05581_youin⟧: structural problem / factor
- {構造的|こうぞうてき}な⟦{欠陥|けっかん}→欠陥：02793_kekkan⟧: structural defect
- {構造的|こうぞうてき}な⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧: structural recession
- {構造的|こうぞうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧: structurally weak

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{体系的|たいけいてき}→体系的：18636_taikeiteki⟧: systematic, organized; describes a method, not a cause
